scope: Native Fountain browser editor in the actual GitLab application; partial toolbar/providers, not full product acceptance
checks: Normal web sign-in and authenticated API version match the image/source pin
Real private project, PNG upload and issue created through authenticated GitLab HTTP APIs
Real browser clipboard Markdown renders through the actual GitLab service, inserts with reference/marks, and supports one-step undo/redo
Actual HTML omits the unused footnote definition; native paste refuses that incomplete projection, retains exact source and recovers through a supported paste

Real footnote dialog cancels without mutation, inserts and directly edits two native notes, undoes/redoes typing independently, and reuses a note without duplicating its definition; all three references stay in the chosen paragraph
Real Enter and typing continue the body before endnotes; no automatic root typing paragraph appears after the terminal editable note

Keyboard-accessible controls remove one reference without deleting its body, or delete a whole note and its references; Undo restores both operations; a 360px dialog retains its draft and cancels without inserting
Current desktop toolbar keeps attachment, paste and media actions on one row; media deletion remains visibly separated; note dialogs and note/media controls pass scoped accessibility checks

Actual label editor retains exact-collision and HTTP-failure drafts, retries successfully, preserves native IDs, updates shared references atomically with Undo/Redo, and refuses a real GitLab case-folded collision
An unused note’s long source label occupies its own wrapping line above its body at desktop and 360px, without horizontal overflow
An unused definition renames through real bounded host rendering without losing its body; Undo restores its label/reference, and a 360px draft cancels without publishing a label change

Trusted copy includes both owned footnote bodies; native paste creates two fresh identities and collision-free source labels, retains shared references and bold text, and one Undo/Redo restores the whole graph
Native Fountain toolbar formats actual browser selection; undo and redo update both document and view
Rebuilt real host hands current rich content to source mode and reopens it without a stale cached value
Four copied/original definitions retain their source labels, bodies and marks in the saved Markdown and actual reader (saved)
All six real reader references and their individual backlinks navigate to the correct copied/original note (saved)
Native rich typing and UI save persisted the added paragraph and retained the seeded content in the server record
An actual empty comment paints its placeholder, hides it on focus/typing and restores empty state after real comment persistence
An initially empty native Fountain composer creates a real GitLab discussion comment and clears after successful persistence
Actual unsupported saved Markdown refuses editing through Retry; explicit recovery enables a local draft, cancelled without changing the server original
Four copied/original definitions retain their source labels, bodies and marks in the saved Markdown and actual reader (reopened)
All six real reader references and their individual backlinks navigate to the correct copied/original note (reopened)
Private issue is unavailable to an unauthenticated browser context
The saved unused footnote definition remains byte-for-byte unchanged after actual application restart
Four copied/original definitions retain their source labels, bodies and marks in the saved Markdown and actual reader (restart)
All six real reader references and their individual backlinks navigate to the correct copied/original note (restart)
Exact saved server source, authenticated session and uploaded image survive an actual application-container restart
secrets: Credential stays in protected task-container configuration and process memory; no credential values, traces or browser storage-state files are recorded
